attempts.raw:
{
  "title": "School Enrolment & Infrastructure Dashboard",
  "subtitle": "Tracking enrolment trends, gender balance, and facility gaps across schools",
  "panels": [
    {
      "id": "p1",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Total Schools",
      "sql": "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT \"School Code\") AS n FROM \"school_enrolment_by_year\"",
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p2",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Total Enrolment (2024)",
      "sql": "SELECT SUM(\"Girls 2024\" + \"Boys 2024\") AS n FROM \"school_enrolment_by_year\"",
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p3",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Schools with Functional Girls' Toilets",
      "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM \"school_infrastructure\" WHERE \"Toilets functional (girls)\" = 'Yes'",
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p4",
      "kind": "line",
      "title": "Enrolment Trend by Gender",
      "sql": "SELECT '2022' AS year, SUM(\"Girls 2022\") AS girls, SUM(\"Boys 2022\") AS boys FROM \"school_enrolment_by_year\" UNION ALL SELECT '2023', SUM(\"Girls 2023\"), SUM(\"Boys 2023\") FROM \"school_enrolment_by_year\" UNION ALL SELECT '2024', SUM(\"Girls 2024\"), SUM(\"Boys 2024\") FROM \"school_enrolment_by_year\" ORDER BY 1",
      "x": "year",
      "y": ["girls", "boys"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p5",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Girls vs Boys Enrolment (2024)",
      "sql": "SELECT 'Girls' AS gender, SUM(\"Girls 2024\") AS count FROM \"school_enrolment_by_year\" UNION ALL SELECT 'Boys', SUM(\"Boys 2024\") FROM \"school_enrolment_by_year\"",
      "x": "gender",
      "y": ["count"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p6",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Infrastructure Gaps",
      "sql": "SELECT 'No Girls Toilets' AS gap, COUNT(*) AS count FROM \"school_infrastructure\" WHERE \"Toilets functional (girls)\" = 'No' UNION ALL SELECT 'No Drinking Water', COUNT(*) FROM \"school_infrastructure\" WHERE \"Drinking water\" = 'No' UNION ALL SELECT 'No Electricity', COUNT(*) FROM \"school_infrastructure\" WHERE \"Electricity\" = 'No'",
      "x": "gap",
      "y": ["count"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p7",
      "kind": "table",
      "title": "Schools with Multiple Infrastructure Gaps",
      "sql": "SELECT \"School Code\", \"Toilets functional (girls)\" AS toilets, \"Drinking water\" AS water, \"Electricity\" AS electricity FROM \"school_infrastructure\" WHERE (\"Toilets functional (girls)\" = 'No' OR \"Drinking water\" = 'No' OR \"Electricity\" = 'No') ORDER BY \"School Code\" LIMIT 10"
    }
  ],
  "narrative": "The dashboard covers {{p1}} schools with a total 2024 enrolment of {{p2}} students. \n\nEnrolment trends show a steady increase from 2022 to 2024 for both genders, with girls' enrolment reaching {{p4[2].girls}} and boys' enrolment reaching {{p4[2].boys}} in 2024. \n\nIn 2024, girls account for {{p5[0].count}} students while boys account for {{p5[1].count}} students. \n\nInfrastructure gaps remain a concern, with {{p6[0].count}} schools lacking functional girls' toilets, {{p6[1].count}} lacking drinking water, and {{p6[2].count}} lacking electricity. \n\nThe table highlights specific schools with multiple gaps, starting with {{p7}}."
}
